_asset_library_note: Path to an unzipped CC0 library (e.g. Kenney All-in-1). Run scripts/index_library.py on it once, then find_asset.py searches it automatically. Leave empty if unused.

ghibli.style: Soft painterly Japanese animation style inspired by classic Studio Ghibli films: gentle watercolor-textured shading, warm natural morning light, rounded friendly character proportions with simple expressive faces, clean hand-drawn linework, muted earthy palette with soft greens and warm creams, cozy lived-in domestic detail. No photorealism, no hard gradients, no text or lettering anywhere in the image.
ghibli.notes: Checkout Rush game art. Warm, optimistic, storybook. Palette doubles as the UI theme; distinctions never rely on colour alone.

house.style: Flat vector-style illustration with soft rounded geometry, clean bold outlines of uniform weight, generous negative space, and a warm friendly tone. Slight paper-grain texture. No gradients meshes, no drop shadows, no photorealism.
house.notes: Designed for undergraduate teaching apps. Optimistic but not childish.

diagram-support.style: Minimal monochrome line illustration, single stroke weight, no fill, technical-drawing feel.
diagram-support.notes: For decorative marks that sit beside real hand-authored diagrams without competing with them.

lab.style: Clean semi-realistic scientific illustration, muted naturalistic colour, subtle cel shading, textbook-plate feel.
lab.notes: For biology / chemistry / physics course apps.
